services.value: Micro-Methods provides analytical testing/analysis of water, soil, and air, including EPA listed environmental contaminants, SW-846 methods, Clean Water Act (CWA) methods, NIOSH methods, OSHA methods, and EPA methods, as well as cleanup/remediation analytical testing and certified asbestos air-monitoring/lead certified inspections. It also offers field services such as groundwater, wastewater, and sewage analysis; soil/sludge analysis; petroleum/oils/gas testing; air pollution/emissions testing; dredge spoil characterizations; pesticide analysis; industrial waste stream characterization; chemical analysis of bioaccumulation; and industrial hygiene services including asbestos bulk analysis, organic vapor analysis, inorganic particulate analysis, mold spore testing, lead base paint testing, and indoor air quality.
